Package com.aspose.cells_foss

Class AutoFilterSupport

java.lang.Object
com.aspose.cells_foss.AutoFilterSupport
public final class AutoFilterSupport extends Object
Provides utility methods for auto-filter support. This is a helper class with only static methods.

  • Method Details

    • normalizeOptionalRange

      public static String normalizeOptionalRange(String value, String parameterName)
      Normalizes an optional range value to a valid cell or range reference. Returns an empty string if the value is null or whitespace. Throws CellsException if the value is not a valid range reference.
      Parameters:
      value - the range value to normalize
      parameterName - the name of the parameter (for error messages)
      Returns:
      the normalized range reference, or empty string if null/whitespace

    • normalizeRequiredRange

      public static String normalizeRequiredRange(String value, String parameterName)
      Normalizes a required range value to a valid cell or range reference. Throws CellsException if the value is null, whitespace, or not a valid range reference.
      Parameters:
      value - the range value to normalize
      parameterName - the name of the parameter (for error messages)
      Returns:
      the normalized range reference

    • tryNormalizeRange

      public static boolean tryNormalizeRange(String value, String[] normalized)
      Tries to normalize a range value to a valid cell or range reference.
      Parameters:
      value - the range value to normalize
      normalized - output holder for the normalized range
      Returns:
      true if normalization succeeded; false otherwise

    • normalizeText

      public static String normalizeText(String value, String parameterName)
      Normalizes text by trimming whitespace. Throws NullPointerException if the value is null.
      Parameters:
      value - the text value to normalize
      parameterName - the name of the parameter (for error messages)
      Returns:
      the trimmed text value

    • normalizeOptionalText

      public static String normalizeOptionalText(String value)
      Normalizes optional text by trimming whitespace. Returns an empty string if the value is null or whitespace.
      Parameters:
      value - the text value to normalize
      Returns:
      the trimmed text, or empty string if null/whitespace

    • parseOperatorOrDefault

      public static com.aspose.cells_foss.core.AutoFilterModel.FilterOperatorType parseOperatorOrDefault(String value)
      Parses a filter operator string into a FilterOperatorType. Returns FilterOperatorType.Equal if the value is null, whitespace, or unrecognized.
      Parameters:
      value - the operator string
      Returns:
      the parsed FilterOperatorType, or Equal if invalid
